Class Fight

java.lang.Object
models.game.Fight
public class Fight extends Object
Represents a fight between two Bugémon teams.

Manages turn order via a boolean isPlayerTurn, attacks, on-field Bugémon switches, and determines whether the battle is over and who won.

Both teams are deep-copied at construction to avoid mutating the player's original teams.

    • Fight

      public Fight(TeamBugemon teamPlayer, TeamBugemon teamCPU)
      Constructs a fight between two teams. Initialises each Bugémon's HP, marks ownership, and places the first Bugémon of the player's team and the first of the enemy's team on the field.
      Parameters:
      teamPlayer - the player's team
      teamCPU - the enemy team
